subscription.a: Explore+ aapki rozana ki likes ki hadd khatam kar deta hai, dikhata hai ke kisne aapko pehle hi pasand kiya, Pass ki hui profile wapas laane deta hai (Rewind), aur har profile ke saath aapka match score dikhata hai, monthly ya yearly plan par.

legal.title: Privacy policy aur sharait
legal.readTermsOnline: Service ki sharait browser mein kholein
legal.contactLine: In dastavezaat ke baare mein sawal hai? {email} par email karein.
legal.privacyIntro: Lovebirds Pakistan mein baaligh afraad ke liye aik matchmaking app hai. Yeh policy batati hai ke hum aap se kya maloomat lete hain, kyun lete hain, kaun unhein dekh sakta hai, aur aap unhein kaise delete karwa sakte hain.
legal.termsIntro: Yeh sharait aap ke aur Lovebirds ke darmiyan muahida hain. Account bana kar aap inhein qubool karte hain. Agar aap inhein qubool nahi karte to app istemal na karein.

whoWeAre.title: 1. Hum kaun hain
whoWeAre.body: Lovebirds ("hum") is app ko chalate hain aur neeche bayan ki gayi maloomat ke data controller hain. Is policy se mutalliq kisi bhi baat ke liye, bashamool apna data dekhne ya delete karwane ki darkhwast, aap hum se {email} par rabta kar sakte hain.

dataWeCollect.title: 2. Hum kya jama karte hain
dataWeCollect.body:
Account ki tafseelat: aap ka email address aur password (sirf salted hash ki shakal mein — hum ise kabhi nahi dekhte).

Profile ki tafseelat: aap ka naam, tareekh-e-paidaish, gender, sheher, taaruf, aap kya dhoond rahe hain, aur rishte ke woh khane jo aap bharte hain (mazhab, firqa, taleem, khandani pas-e-manzar, tayyari).

Tasaveer, video aur awaaz: aap ki profile tasaveer, aur agar aap shamil karein to video intro aur voice intro.

Tasdeeqi selfie: signup ke waqt li gayi selfie, yeh dekhne ke liye ke profile ke peeche asal insaan hai. Yeh kabhi aap ke profile par ya doosre members ko nahi dikhayi jati.

CNIC: aap ka CNIC number aur CNIC card ki tasveer, dono signup par lazmi hain. Jab aap card ki tasveer lete hain to app aap ke phone par hi us par chhapa number parhti hai (Google ML Kit ke zariye, jo phone ke andar chalta hai aur tasveer kahin nahi bhejta) aur check karti hai ke yeh aap ke likhe hue number se milta hai. Hum aap ke CNIC number ka aik yak-tarfa, key wala fingerprint (hash) bhi rakhte hain taake aik CNIC se sirf aik account ban sake; is fingerprint se number wapas nahi nikala ja sakta. Aap ka CNIC number aur card ki tasveer kabhi doosre members ko nahi dikhayi jati, aur signup ke baad badli nahi ja sakti — durusti chahiye ho to {email} par email karein.

Maqam: sirf woh sheher jo aap chunte hain. Hum aap ke phone ki location jama nahi karte.

Chat: app mein bheje gaye paighamaat, voice notes aur tasaveer, aur yeh ke aap ne inhein kis ko bheja.

Khareedari: kya aap ke paas Explore+ subscription hai, us ka plan aur renewal ki tareekh. Payment khud Google Play karta hai; hum aap ke card ki tafseelat kabhi nahi dekhte.

Istemal aur device: aap ne app aakhri baar kab kholi, kis ko like kiya, kis ko block kiya, aur kya report kiya — jis par hifazati jaiza chalta hai — aur aap ke device ka push-notification token.

howWeUse.title: 3. Hum ise kyun istemal karte hain
howWeUse.body:
Aap ka account banane aur chalane, yeh check karne ke ke aap ki CNIC ki tasveer aap ke CNIC number se milti hai aur har CNIC se sirf aik account bane, aap ka profile doosre members ko dikhane, match tajweez karne, aap ke paighamaat aur notifications pohanchane, rozana like ki hadd aur Explore+ subscription lagoo karne, reports ka jaiza lene aur community ko mehfooz rakhne, aur qanooni taqazay poore karne ke liye.

Hum aap ka data farokht nahi karte. Hum aap ki tasaveer, selfie, CNIC ya paighamaat ko ishtiharaat ke liye istemal nahi karte, aur na hi inhein machine-learning models ki tarbiyat ke liye istemal karte hain.

legalBasis.title: 4. Aap ki razamandi
legalBasis.body: Aap apna profile, tasaveer, selfie aur CNIC razakaarana taur par, match hone ke liye dete hain. Aap apna account delete karke yeh razamandi kisi bhi waqt wapas le sakte hain. Delete karne ke baad hum sirf woh thora sa data rakhte hain jis ka qanoon ya koi jaari hifazati tehqeeq taqaza kare — dekhein "Hum kitni der rakhte hain".

sharing.title: 5. Ise aur kaun dekhta hai
sharing.body:
Doosre members aap ka profile dekhte hain: naam, umar, sheher, tasaveer, taaruf aur woh khane jo aap ne bhare. Woh aap ka email, password, CNIC, tasdeeqi selfie ya durust maqam nahi dekhte.

App chalane ke liye hum yeh service providers istemal karte hain. Har aik data sirf hamari hidayat par aur sirf likhe gaye maqsad ke liye process karta hai:
• Supabase — aap ka account, profile, paighamaat aur upload ki gayi files mehfooz rakhta hai.
• RevenueCat — aap ki Explore+ subscription ka hisaab rakhta hai (aap ki account ID aur khareedari ki soorat-e-haal). Payment Google Play karta hai.
• Expo aur Google Firebase Cloud Messaging — push notifications pohanchate hain (aap ke device ka push token aur notification ka text).
• Brevo ya Resend — aap ke email par aik baar istemal hone wale tasdeeqi codes bhejte hain.

Google ML Kit aap ki CNIC tasveer ka number sirf aap ke phone par parhta hai; is ke liye Google ko kuch nahi bheja jata.

Hum qanoon nafiz karne wale idaron ko data sirf us soorat mein dete hain jab qanoonan lazim ho, ya kisi ki jaan ko lahiq qabil-e-aitbar khatre ki tehqeeq ke liye zaroori ho.

retention.title: 6. Hum kitni der rakhte hain
retention.body:
Aap ka account khula rehne tak aap ka data mehfooz rehta hai. Account delete karne par aap ka profile, tasaveer, CNIC ki tafseelat, matches aur paighamaat hamare faal systems se hazf ho jate hain, aur khufiya backups 30 din ke andar khatam ho jate hain.

Do istisna: kisi khuli hifazati report ya pabandi wale account se jure record 12 maah tak rakhe jate hain taake wohi shakhs foran wapas na aa sake; aur jo record qanoonan rakhna lazim ho, woh muqarrara muddat tak rakhe jate hain.

yourRights.title: 7. Aap ke huqooq
yourRights.body:
Aap apna zyada tar profile data kisi bhi waqt "Profile mein tarmeem" se dekh aur durust kar sakte hain. Aap ka CNIC number aur CNIC tasveer signup ke baad tabdeel nahi hote; durusti chahiye ho to {email} par email karein.

Aap {email} par email karke apne data ki naqal, us ki durusti, ya kisi makhsoos istemal par aitraz bhi kar sakte hain. Hum 30 din ke andar jawab dete hain.

deleteAccount.title: 8. Account delete karna
deleteAccount.body:
App mein: Settings → Privacy aur hifazat → Account delete karein. Yeh foran lagoo hota hai aur wapas nahi ho sakta.

App ke baghair: jis email se aap ne signup kiya tha usi se {email} par email karein, subject "Delete my account" likhein. Hum darkhwast ki tasdeeq karke 7 din ke andar account delete kar dete hain.

Kya delete hota hai: aap ka account, profile, tasaveer, video aur voice intro, tasdeeqi selfie, CNIC number, CNIC tasveer aur CNIC fingerprint, matches, likes aur paighamaat. Khufiya backups 30 din ke andar khatam ho jate hain. Sirf woh record rakhe ja sakte hain jo "Hum kitni der rakhte hain" mein likhe hain.

security.title: 9. Hum ise kaise mehfooz rakhte hain
security.body:
Data muntaqili ke douran encrypted rehta hai. Passwords hash kiye jate hain aur kabhi parhi jane wali shakal mein mehfooz nahi hote. Aap ki CNIC tasveer aur tasdeeqi selfie aik niji storage mein rehti hain jise sirf aap aur hamara jaiza amal parh sakta hai. Profile tasaveer, intros, voice notes aur chat mein bheji gayi tasaveer lambe, na-qabil-e-andaza web links par rakhi jati hain taake app inhein dikha sake; yeh kahin list ya search nahi hotin, lekin jis ke paas bilkul wohi link ho woh file khol sakta hai. Baaqi har cheez har table par row-level security qawaid se mehfooz hai, is liye aik account doosre ke paighamaat ya dastavezaat nahi parh sakta.

Koi nizam mukammal mehfooz nahi hota. Agar kisi khilaf warzi se aap ka data mutasir hua to hum aap ko aur mutalliqa idare ko qanoon ke mutabiq mutla karenge.

ageLimit.title: 10. Sirf baaligh afraad ke liye
ageLimit.body: Lovebirds 18 saal ya us se zyada umar ke afraad ke liye hai. Hum signup par tareekh-e-paidaish poochte hain aur 18 saal se kam umar ke accounts qubool nahi karte. Agar hamein maloom ho ke koi account nabaligh ka hai to hum use aur us ka data hazf kar dete hain. Agar aap ko lage ke koi nabaligh app istemal kar raha hai to {email} par email karein.

changes.title: 11. Is policy mein tabdeeliyan
changes.body: Agar hum is policy mein koi aisi tabdeeli karein jo aap par numayan asar dale to nafiz hone se pehle hum aap ko app mein bata denge. Oopar darj tareekh hamesha wohi nuskha zahir karti hai jo aap parh rahe hain.

contact.title: 12. Hum se rabta
contact.body: Privacy se mutalliq kisi bhi sawal, data ki darkhwast ya shikayat ke liye {email} par email karein. Agar aap hamare jawab se mutmain na hon to aap apne muqami data tahaffuz idare se shikayat kar sakte hain.

eligibility.title: 1. Aap ka 18 saal ka hona lazim hai
eligibility.body: Aap Lovebirds sirf usi soorat istemal kar sakte hain jab aap 18 saal ya us se zyada umar ke hon aur qanoonan yeh muahida karne ke ahal hon. Aap signup par apni umar ki tasdeeq karte hain. 18 saal se kam umar mein, ya kisi nabaligh ki janib se, account banana in sharait ki khilaf warzi hai aur hum aisa account hazf kar denge.

yourAccount.title: 2. Aap ka account
yourAccount.body: Fi shakhs aik account. Durust tafseelat dein, aisi tasaveer lagayein jo waqai aap ki hon, aur apna password apne paas rakhein. Aap ke account se hone wale har amal ke zimmedar aap hain. Agar aap ko lage ke kisi aur ko is tak rasai hai to {email} par hamein batayein.

acceptableUse.title: 3. App kaise istemal karein
acceptableUse.body: Lovebirds dosti, taalluq ya shadi ke liye logon se milne ki jagah hai. Doosre members ke saath waisa sulook karein jaisa aap apne ghar walon ke liye chahte hain. Guftagu usi raftaar se barhayein jo dono ko qubool ho, aur "nahi" ka ehtiram pehli hi baar karein.

prohibited.title: 4. Kya mana hai
prohibited.body:
Aap yeh nahi kar sakte: kisi aur ka roop dharna ya kisi aur ki tasaveer istemal karna; kisi member ko haraan karna, dhamkana, taaqub karna ya badsulooki karna; nabaligh se mutalliq koi bhi mawad, bashamool jinsi mawad, bhejna ya shaya karna; members se paise, sarmayakari ya maali tafseelat mangna; tijarti ya tashheeri mawad bhejna; nafrat angez mawad ya kisi ke mazhab, maslak, nasal, jins ya maoori par hamla karne wala mawad dalna; kisi member ki niji maloomat, tasaveer ya paighamaat app se bahar share karna; service ke khilaf bots ya khudkaar tools istemal karna; ya aise accounts, data ya systems tak rasai ki koshish karna jo aap ke nahi.

Hum aise mawad ko hatate hain aur khilaf warzi karne wale accounts moattal ya khatam kar dete hain.

contentLicence.title: 5. Aap ka mawad
contentLicence.body: Aap ki tasaveer aur tehreerein aap hi ki hain. Inhein shaya karke aap hamein service chalane ki gharz se inhein app ke andar rakhne, mehfooz karne aur dikhane ki ijazat dete hain. Yeh ijazat usi waqt khatam ho jati hai jab aap woh mawad ya apna account hazf kar dein. Jo kuch aap upload karte hain us ka haq rakhna aap ki zimmedari hai.

safety.title: 6. Hifazat aur reporting
safety.body:
Jo bhi aap ko bechain kare use block aur report karein — dono chat screen aur har profile se dastyab hain. Hamari hifazati team har report ka jaiza leti hai.

Hum members ki mujrimana pas manzar ki jaanch nahi kar sakte, aur tasdeeqi badge kisi ke kirdar ya niyat ki zamanat nahi. Awami jagah par milein. Kisi qabil-e-aitmaad fard ko bata kar jayein ke aap kahan ja rahe hain. Kisi member ko kabhi paise na bhejein.

subscriptions.title: 7. Explore+ aur adaigiyan
subscriptions.body: Explore+ aik ikhtiyari ada shuda subscription hai. Qeemat, shamil sahulyat aur billing ki muddat khareedne se pehle dikhai jati hai. Subscription mansookh karne tak khudkaar taur par tajdeed hoti hai, aur aap ise usi app store se mansookh karte hain jahan se khareedi — billing aur raqam ki wapsi usi store ki policy ke tehat hoti hai, hamare nahi. Subscription khatam hone se aap ka account hazf nahi hota.

termination.title: 8. Muahida khatam karna
termination.body:
Aap kisi bhi waqt Settings → Privacy aur hifazat se apna account hazf kar sakte hain.

Hum aisa account moattal ya khatam kar sakte hain jo in sharait ki khilaf warzi kare, jis ke baare mein hamein maqool taur par dhoka dahi ya khatre ka andesha ho, ya jahan qanoonan aisa karna lazim ho. Jahan mehfooz aur qanooni hoga, hum wajah batayenge. Sangeen khilaf warziyan — nabaligh se mutalliq koi bhi maamla, qabil-e-aitbar dhamkiyan, ya dhoka dahi — account foran aur mustaqil khatam kar deti hain.

disclaimers.title: 9. Hum kya wada nahi karte
disclaimers.body: Hum app jaisi hai waisi faraham karte hain. Hum yeh wada nahi karte ke aap ko match milega, ke har member wohi hai jo khud ko batata hai, ya ke service bila taatul aur be aib chalegi. Members apne tarz-e-amal ke khud zimmedar hain, app ke andar bhi aur bahar bhi.

liability.title: 10. Hamari zimmedari ki hudood
liability.body: Qanoon jis hadd tak ijazat de, hum bilwasta ya nateejatan hone wale nuqsan ke, ya doosre members ke tarz-e-amal ke zimmedar nahi. Yahan koi baat us zimmedari ko mehdood nahi karti jise qanoonan mehdood nahi kiya ja sakta, bashamool hamari ghaflat se hone wali maut ya jismani nuqsan, ya dhoka dahi.

disputes.title: 11. Tanazaat aur qabil-e-itlaq qanoon
disputes.body:
Yeh sharait Islami Jamhuriya Pakistan ke qawaneen ke taabe hain, aur kisi bhi tanaza par Pakistan ki adaalaton ko daira-e-ikhtiyar hasil hai.

Adalat jane se pehle barah-e-karam {email} par email karein — zyada tar shikayaat isi tarah jald hal ho jati hain, aur hum 30 din ke andar jawab denge.

changes.title: 12. In sharait mein tabdeeliyan
changes.body: Koi numayan tabdeeli nafiz hone se pehle hum aap ko app mein bata denge. Is tareekh ke baad app istemal karte rehna is baat ka matlab hai ke aap nai sharait qubool karte hain; agar nahi, to apna account hazf kar dein.
